Weekly scheduled capacity by airport pair (one direction only: origin -> destination), all marketing carriers combined, codeshares removed.
week_start = Monday. status 'operated' up to the last completed week; 'filed' = future schedules as filed with the provider (subject to change).
Airport codes are IATA (TFU = Chengdu Tianfu, PVG = Shanghai Pudong, PEK = Beijing Capital, HND/NRT = Tokyo, ICN = Seoul Incheon, KIX = Osaka).
